en: Born in '81, female, 42, 40 years old, one boy, 5.

text: 我爸，退休，以前水手长，去过世界各地，不爱惜身体，脊椎问题较大，以前腰做过手术，有钢板，71岁。
en: My father, retired, formerly a boatswain, has travelled all over the world, doesn't take care of his health, has serious spinal problems, had surgery on his lower back before and has steel plates in, 71 years old.

text: 我妈，农村妇女，高血脂。
en: My mother, a rural woman, has hyperlipidaemia.
70 years old

text: 我妈把娃带大。
en: My mother brought the child up.

text: 我家在下面县市的海边小山村（靠山靠海），开车1.5小时路程。
en: My home is in a small seaside village in a lower-tier county-level city (backed by hills and facing the sea), a 1.5-hour drive away.

text: 我公公74，退休
en: My father-in-law is 74, retired.

text: 婆婆，退休，腰椎间盘突出，膝盖关节退化，高血压高血脂，70岁，坐轮椅，从哈尔滨刚过来要儿子孙子陪伴着度过余生。
en: My mother-in-law, retired, has a herniated lumbar disc, knee joint degeneration, high blood pressure and hyperlipidaemia, 70 years old, in a wheelchair, just came from Harbin and wants to spend her remaining years with her son and grandson.

text: 父母已老，娃还未长大。
en: Our parents are already old, but the child is not yet grown up.

text: 老公，工厂技术员，和我一样双休，不加班，比我还自在，校招进去的，要呆到退休。
en: My husband, a factory technician, has two days off a week like me, no overtime, more at ease than me even, got in through campus recruitment, and intends to stay until retirement.

text: 工作稳定。
en: The job is stable.

text: 没啥上进心。
en: Not much ambition.

text: 工资7k和我没降薪前差不多吧。
en: Salary 7k, about the same as before my pay cut.

text: 比较顾家，做饭，陪孩子玩，不抽烟喝酒，唯一爱好王者。
en: Quite family-oriented; he cooks, plays with the child, doesn't smoke or drink, and his only hobby is Honor of Kings.

text: 好朋友的爸爸上个月没了，70多岁，我深深的感觉，和父母的缘分见一面少一面，只能多回家看看。
en: A good friend's father passed away last month, in his seventies; I deeply feel that my bond with my parents grows thinner with every meeting, and I can only go home more often to see them.

text: 去年和今年爸爸各住院了一次。
en: Last year and this year, my father was hospitalised once each.

text: 各种请假陪床，+娃发烧等。
en: All sorts of leave taken to sit with him in hospital, + the child's fever, etc.

text: 职场真是对中年人不友好。
en: The workplace really isn't kind to middle-aged people.

text: 工作，不太稳定。
en: The job isn't very stable.

text: 又很稳定的不稳定，14年入职，每年裁员好几次，目前效益不好，陷入工作的忧虑中。
en: Yet it's a very stable kind of instability; I joined in 2014, with several rounds of layoffs every year; the company is doing poorly at present, and I've sunk into worry about work.

text: 改善居住环境和娃上学，去年买了个房子，房贷每月6100公积金有1000两个人加起来吧。
en: To improve the living environment and for the child's schooling, I bought a flat last year; the monthly mortgage is 6,100, and with the 1,000 housing fund it comes to that between the two of us.

text: 而工资已经降到了5k不用纠结是税前税后，没税，保险前后一样，因为吃饭是发了点钱。
en: And the salary has already dropped to 5k; no need to fuss over whether it's pre- or post-tax, there's no tax, and insurance is the same before and after, because a bit of money is given out for meals.

text: 还有工龄。
en: There's also length of service to consider.

text: 我已不再年轻，和一群年轻人抢机会谈何容易。
en: I am no longer young; competing with a crowd of young people for opportunities is no easy thing.

text: 有工作886，我不想去。
en: There's a job with an 886 schedule, and I don't want to go.

text: 我想给娃一个好点的未来，想多陪陪娃，多陪陪父母。
en: I want to give the child a better future, want to spend more time with the child, more time with my parents.

text: 好在双方父母都不需要赡养，就偶尔给他们买点好吃的就行。
en: Thankfully neither set of parents needs to be supported; just occasionally buying them something nice to eat will do.

text: 也经常发愁，发愁双方父母生病往后是常态，就婆婆180斤生病，我这80多斤的也搬不动呀。
en: I also worry a lot, worried that both sets of parents falling ill will be the norm from now on; just take my mother-in-law, 180 jin, if she falls ill, I, at just over 80 jin, couldn't even lift her.

text: 年轻的时候也曾仗剑走天涯，转眼已经满头生华发，去哪里身不由已。
en: When I was young I too dreamt of travelling the world with a sword; in the blink of an eye my hair is full of silver strands, and where I go is no longer my own choice.

text: 以前没买房子的时候总想躺平，现在总想着活到老干到老，活出自己的价值，不靠别人。
en: Before buying a flat I always wanted to lie flat; now I always think of working till I'm old, living out my own worth, not relying on others.

text: 尽可能帮帮娃。
en: Help the child as much as I can.

text: 据我从身边朋友父母的年龄总结，65周岁退休，我可能也就能活到70岁领5年退休金？
en: From what I've gathered about the ages of friends' parents around me, with retirement at 65, I might only live to 70 and collect a pension for 5 years?

text: 所以我最近觉得买退休金或者补充养老金是个特别没用的事儿。
en: So lately I've felt that buying an annuity or a supplementary pension is a particularly useless thing.

text: 之前买过两个养老保险，1个每年2000交10年已经交了6年。
en: I previously bought two endowment insurance policies; one at 2,000 a year over 10 years, already paid for 6 years.

text: 另外一个是支付宝全民养老金月扣款，今年已经停了。
en: The other was Alipay's All-Citizen Pension with monthly deductions, stopped this year.

text: 踏实工作，努力学习有换工作的实力，有一个稳定有爱的家庭。
en: Work steadily, study hard to build the ability to change jobs, and have a stable, loving family.

text: 40岁，父母健在，娃还很可爱，老公对我很好，这就是这一阶段的岁月静好，现世安稳。
en: At 40, my parents are still alive, the child is still lovely, and my husband is very good to me; this is the quiet beauty of the years at this stage, the peace and stability of the present world.

text: 希望，岁月走的慢一点，能陪父母多走一程。
en: I hope time will pass a little more slowly, so I can walk a little further with my parents.
Updated 2023.4

text: 工资去年降薪后来又恢复了，就是6k多，公司仍然每月亏损，保持一年裁员好几轮的节奏。
en: Last year the salary was cut and then restored, now just over 6k; the company is still losing money every month, keeping up the rhythm of several rounds of layoffs a year.

text: 我下一次签合同是2024年底的无固定期限劳动合同，感觉好遥远，应该是不行吧。
en: My next contract is an open-ended labour contract at the end of 2024; it feels so far away, probably won't happen.

text: 公司到时还要不要这部分业务都不知道，未来看起来很迷茫。
en: Whether the company will still want this part of the business by then is anyone's guess; the future looks very uncertain.

text: 也有可能我撑不住这两个月。
en: It's also possible I won't last these two months.

text: 老公涨薪了1k，现在8k
en: My husband got a 1k raise, now 8k.

text: 我还是个小领导,部门负责人，一直工作努力，还算有点技术，有啥用。
en: I'm still a minor leader, head of the department; I've always worked hard and have some technical skill, but what's the use.

text: 在2023年的大环境下，我突然发现，可能真的是1.稳定最重要 2.选择比努力更重要
en: In the general climate of 2023, I suddenly realised that perhaps it really is: 1. stability matters most, 2. choice matters more than effort.

text: 所以当年结婚时我工资5000多，老公工资3000多，然后我们的差距越来越小，直至于他超过我。
en: So when we married, my salary was over 5,000 and my husband's over 3,000; then the gap between us grew smaller and smaller, until he overtook me.

text: 不上进竟然也不是什么坏事。
en: Not being ambitious turns out not to be such a bad thing either.

text: 房贷100W，利率5.35今年降到了4.95
en: Mortgage 1 million, interest rate 5.35, dropped to 4.95 this year.

text: 每个月房贷少了100多块钱。
en: The monthly mortgage is over 100 yuan less.

text: 坏消息：房子延期了。
en: Bad news: the flat has been delayed.

text: 好消息：还在盖
en: Good news: still under construction.

text: 娃9.1要过去上小学，所以我要过去租房子。
en: The child starts primary school on 9.1, so I need to go over there and rent a flat.

text: 今年上半年，我爸住院的指标已经完了，就在这周。
en: In the first half of this year, my father's hospitalisation quota was already used up, just this week.

text: 过完年，我已经41周岁，超过用人单位40岁以下的招人要求。
en: After the New Year, I'll be 41 full years old, exceeding employers' recruitment requirement of under 40.

text: 原来对我开放的招聘信息已经关闭，未来，我可能要转行谋求新的发展了。
en: Recruitment postings that were once open to me have already closed; in future I may have to change careers and seek new development.

text: 打听了几个同行新如今的工作，做按摩的，餐厅服务员…
en: I asked around about what a few former colleagues are doing now: massage work, restaurant waiter...

text: 看看我，目前还一筹莫展中。
en: Looking at me, I'm still at a complete loss.

text: 观察周围40岁以上的同事朋友，发现他们有一个共同点：他们一方面承受着“上有老下有小”的责任，一方面拥有更强烈的发展动机、更丰富的职业资源。
en: Observing colleagues and friends over 40 around me, I found they share one common trait: on the one hand they bear the responsibility of 'having elders above and children below', and on the other they possess a stronger drive to get on and richer professional resources.

text: 曾经跟他们探讨过这个问题，对他们而言，40岁到底意味着什么。
en: I once discussed this question with them: what does turning 40 actually mean to them.

text: 然而每个人的回答都不一样，或者说他们看重的维度是不同的。
en: Yet everyone's answer was different, or rather the dimensions they value are different.

text: 有人说，好像到了这个年纪才算一个完整的人，家庭、事业、还有自己。
en: Some said that it's only at this age one becomes a complete person—family, career, and oneself.

text: 有人说，一切仿佛即将尘埃落定，但依然想要再拼一把，给家人更好的生活。
en: Some said everything seems about to settle, yet they still want to make one more push, to give their family a better life.

text: 有人说，觉得自己还年轻大有可为，不过也知道了…
en: Some said they feel still young and full of promise, but have also come to know...

text: 人老会是什么样。
en: What it is like to grow old.

text: 有人说，现在是比以前更淡然，因为我犯了足够多的错。
en: Some said they are now more composed than before, because they have made enough mistakes.

text: 也有人说，越来越明白，生活和期待终究不一样，理解了也就包容了，我挺喜欢现在的自己。
en: There were also those who said they increasingly understand that life and expectation are after all not the same; once you understand you become accepting, and they rather like who they are now.

text: 40岁到底是怎样的人生体会？
en: What kind of life experience is 40, after all?

text: 近日，汤臣倍健和人民健康联合发布的短片《你好 四十》，记录了40+人群的真实回答，视频不仅呈现了40+群体的现状，更让人看到了他们在中年如何勇敢面对自己，做出改变的内在力量。
en: Recently, the short film 'Hello, Forty', jointly released by By-Health and People's Health, recorded the real answers of the 40+ crowd. The video not only presents the current state of the 40+ group, but also shows the inner strength with which they bravely face themselves in middle age and make changes.

text: 40岁，是充满困境与危机的年龄，也是新的自我成长的契机与起点。
en: Forty is an age full of predicaments and crises, yet also an opportunity and a starting point for new self-growth.

text: 中年危机，本质上可能是“心理困局”。
en: The mid-life crisis, in essence, may be a 'psychological predicament'.

text: 1965年，精神分析学家艾略特·贾克创造了“中年危机”这个词，他认为人生过半，人必然会面临「生命有限，能力有限」而产生的危机感。
en: In 1965, psychoanalyst Elliott Jaques coined the term 'mid-life crisis'. He believed that once life is more than half over, one inevitably faces a sense of crisis born of 'finite life, finite ability'.

text: 当前40岁的中年人其父母大部分已经年过60，步入老年。
en: Most of today's 40-year-old middle-aged people have parents already past 60, entering old age.

text: 你会明显观察到自己父母的衰老，他们不再健壮，开始忍受一些老年疾病的困扰，开始越来越多的依靠你；
en: You will clearly observe your own parents ageing; they are no longer robust, begin to endure the troubles of some age-related ailments, and start to rely on you more and more;

text: 其次，你也明显开始察觉到自己身体的变化，不再像二三十岁时候那么有精力，疲劳感也不易缓解；同时，社会层面的年龄歧视和淘汰制好像也在不断地提醒你，你已不再年轻。
en: Secondly, you will also clearly begin to notice changes in your own body; you no longer have as much energy as in your twenties and thirties, and fatigue is not easily relieved; at the same time, societal age discrimination and an elimination system seem constantly to remind you that you are no longer young.

text: 诚然变老是每个人必然要面对的现象，但应对“变老”的恐惧却是我们可以改变的。
en: Admittedly, growing old is a phenomenon everyone must inevitably face, yet the fear of 'growing old' is something we can change.

text: 以下三点，有助于你更从容面对中年危机，增加掌控感。
en: The following three points will help you face the mid-life crisis more calmly and increase your sense of control.

text: ①转换成长型思维：
en: ① Shift to a growth mindset:

text: 时常有人会说：“你到40岁，晋升空间差不多就到头了。
en: People often say: "By the time you're 40, your promotion prospects are pretty much at an end.

text: ”如果非要从某个极小的领域或岗位上看，这种情况也许是存在的，但这样的说法也是极短视的。
en: "If you must look at it from some tiny field or particular post, such a situation may exist, but such a statement is also extremely short-sighted.

text: 一旦切换到成长型思维，那么40岁不仅不是结束，反而可能是新的开始。
en: Once you switch to a growth mindset, then 40 is not only not an end, but may instead be a new beginning.

text: 不妨试着盘点一下身边的长辈或那些名人，他们中就有不少是在40岁左右再创事业高峰的。
en: You might as well take stock of the elders around you or those famous figures, quite a few of whom reached a fresh peak in their careers around 40.

text: 比如43岁开创华为的任正非，42岁白手起家的宗庆后。
en: For example, Zhengfei Ren who founded Huawei at 43, and Qinghou Zong who started from scratch at 42.

text: 除了这些名人，其实大部分人也是在40岁后实现财富的越迁；年少成名暴富的，只是少数人。
en: Apart from these famous figures, in fact most people also achieve a leap in wealth after 40; those who become famous young and suddenly rich are only a minority.

text: ②关注积极向：
en: ② Focus on the positive:

text: 随着年龄的增大，体力、精力等流体智力可能有所下降，以至于一部分40多岁的人觉得自己开始走下坡路了。
en: As one grows older, fluid intelligence such as physical strength and energy may decline, so that some people in their forties feel they are starting to go downhill.

text: 其实对比20岁、30岁的人，你积累了更多的经验和资源，你的人格和思想更加成熟，这些同经验相关的晶体智力会随年龄的增加而提升。
en: In fact, compared with people in their twenties and thirties, you have accumulated more experience and resources, and your character and thinking are more mature; this experience-related crystallised intelligence rises with age.

text: 当你尽可能多的提醒自己关注自己优势的一面，你就可以获得更多的成长动力，心怀希望，去挑战更多的可能性。
en: When you remind yourself as much as possible to focus on your strengths, you can gain more motivation for growth, harbour hope, and take on more possibilities.

text: ③增加认知灵活性：
en: ③ Increase cognitive flexibility:

text: 接受无法改变的，改变可以改变的，未必要一条路走到黑。
en: Accept what cannot be changed, change what can be changed; there's no need to go down one path to the very end.

text: 有一次跟一位40多岁的司机师傅聊天，得知他原本是做餐饮的，赶上疫情，餐饮店倒闭了，他就出来做网约车司机。
en: Once I chatted with a driver in his forties and learned he used to be in catering; when the pandemic hit, his restaurant closed down, so he went out and became a ride-hailing driver.

text: 我询问他后面的打算，他说，艰难总会过去，等缓过这段时期，他还是会回去继续做餐饮，毕竟他积累了二十多年的经验。
en: I asked him about his plans ahead; he said hard times will always pass, and once he gets through this period he will still go back to catering, after all he has accumulated over twenty years of experience.

text: 这位司机师傅可以审视当前的实际状况，做出相应的调整和规划，这就是很好的灵活性的体现。
en: This driver can examine the current actual situation and make corresponding adjustments and plans; this is a good demonstration of flexibility.

text: 再比如很多40+的人群开始精简社交，把更多的精力投入到自己和家庭身上，或者培养一些新的爱好，比如“钓鱼”、“瑜伽”、“跳舞”等等。
en: Another example: many in the 40+ group start to streamline their social life, invest more energy in themselves and their families, or take up some new hobbies, such as 'fishing', 'yoga', 'dancing', and so on.

text: 他们并没有完全推翻自己的现有生活，而是更愿意在接纳的基础上做出改变和调整。
en: They do not completely overturn their existing lives, but are more willing to make changes and adjustments on the basis of acceptance.

text: 尽管这些改变看起来只是在“存量”上做的一些关于自我的“增量”，但这种灵活性的体现却可以增强自我掌控感。
en: Although these changes look like mere 'increments' to the self made upon the 'stock', this expression of flexibility can nonetheless strengthen one's sense of self-mastery.

text: 除此之外，锻炼身体、保持健康也是我们可以主动调整的部分。
en: Beyond this, exercising the body and staying healthy are also parts we can actively adjust.

text: 我的真实感受是，年龄越大，越不能像以前那样熬夜了，也越来越重视体检了，并开始了打卡运动。
en: My real feeling is that the older I get, the less I can stay up late as I used to, and the more I value health check-ups; I've also started clocking in for exercise.

text: 坚持运动之后，自然而然也会更关注饮食，关注作息，我的体态和生活习惯也就变得更好了。
en: After keeping up with exercise, naturally I also pay more attention to diet and routine, and my physique and habits get better.

text: 毕竟“健健康康，是家里最重要的事。
en: After all, "being healthy and well is the most important thing in the family.

text: 最后，希望每位40+的朋友可以领悟、调整，改变可以改变的，接受不能改变的，从“变老恐惧”向“成长心态”转变，活成自己想要的样子。
en: Finally, I hope every friend over 40 can realise and adjust, change what can be changed and accept what cannot, shift from 'fear of growing old' to a 'growth mindset', and live the life they want.

text: 如汤臣倍健和人民健康联合推出的《你好 四十》短片中所说：“在全新的未知中， 回答岁月的提问，拼了命的热爱生活，去实现，去蜕变， 保持健康，韧性向前。
en: As said in the short film 'Hello, Forty' jointly launched by By-Health and People's Health: "In a brand-new unknown, answer the questions of the years, love life with all you've got, go and achieve, go and transform, stay healthy, and press forward with resilience.
